Title: Acta et diplomata graeca medii aevi sacra et profana, collecta ediderunt Franciscus Miklosich et Iosephus Muller. Volumen primum: Acta patriarchatus Constantinopolitani MCCCXV-MCCCCII, e codicibus manu scriptis bibliothecae Palatinae Vindobonensis, tomus prior
Creator: Franz Miklosich and Joseph Muller (eds.); the register of the Patriarchate of Constantinople, 1315 to 1402, Greek with Latin summaries and notes
Publisher: Vienna: Carolus Gerold, 1860 ('VINDOBONAE CAROLUS GEROLD MDCCCLX')
Publication Date: 1860
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: the title page reads 'MDCCCLX' (1860) in this scan's OCR (file lines 143 and 182); host record: date 1860, possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
Language: grc (Greek with parallel or following Latin translation; the Latin and Greek share the OCR file; see the content note)
Source: Internet Archive item actaetdiplomata00graegoog (archive.org/details/actaetdiplomata00graegoog), full-text file actaetdiplomata00graegoog_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the Library thread, October 2026.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; the OCR text follows it unchanged. Nothing was stripped, normalised, corrected, re-spaced or retyped (the long s glyph occurs 2 times and was left as found). The Google Books boilerplate page at the head of the OCR is left in place. The OCR text that follows is 2465413 bytes, 1347868 characters and 28939 lines. OCR quality sampled at the title pages and at about 5%, 50% and 95% of the file (lines 1459, 14482 and 27505): Greek polytonic good, with sigma-final and breathing slips; Latin headings clean.
Content note: The first volume of Miklosich and Muller, the patriarchal register edited from the Vienna manuscripts: decisions, letters, synodal acts and appeals of the Patriarchate of Constantinople from 1315 to 1402, printed in Greek with a Latin heading for each document; the contents list at the end runs to documents of 1372-1374 on page 594-595. The file ends with that contents list. The volume includes the documents on the Palamite and Akindynist quarrel and on parish and monastic discipline. The second half of the register (1364-1402, 'tomus alter', volume 2 of 1862) was not found on the host. A second scan, actaetdiplomata01miklgoog (1.5 MB), is a photomechanical reprint with much poorer OCR and was not vendored.
